name: financial-analytics
description: Local-first personal cash-flow manager (web + Android companion)

scripts.start: npm run build -w @fa/web && npm run start -w @fa/server
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @fa/server" "npm run dev -w @fa/web"
scripts.test: npm run test -w @fa/core && npm run test -w @fa/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @fa/core && npm run typecheck -w @fa/server && npm run typecheck -w @fa/web
scripts.mobile: cd apps/mobile && npm install && npx expo start
